hints.tr: Başlangıç kodu kaldırılanları hiç bulmuyor ve sıralamıyor.
hints.en: The starter code never finds the removed ones and does not sort.
Turn them into sets: `sorted(new_set - old_set)` and `sorted(old_set - new_set)`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def endpoint_changes(old, new):
    old_set, new_set = set(old), set(new)
    return {"added": sorted(new_set - old_set), "removed": sorted(old_set - new_set)}

v1 = ["/login", "/search", "/admin", "/old"]
v2 = ["/login", "/search", "/admin", "/export", "/debug"]
report = endpoint_changes(v1, v2)
print("added", report["added"])
print("removed", report["removed"])
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def endpoint_changes(old, new):
    old_set, new_set = set(old), set(new)
    return {"added": sorted(new_set - old_set), "removed": sorted(old_set - new_set)}

v1 = ["/login", "/search", "/admin", "/old"]
v2 = ["/login", "/search", "/admin", "/export", "/debug"]
report = endpoint_changes(v1, v2)
print("added", report["added"])
print("removed", report["removed"])
```
